method: Original-only local distal visual measurements in this pass, with historical exposure to detector results and previous annotations. Provisional measurements, not certified ground truth. Points do not identify biological roots.
coordinates: 4x original crop PNG pixels, proximal-to-tip order. Angle uses image y-down and degrees atan2(dy,dx); negative angles point up.
intervalMeaning: Conservative visual direction interval over the stated native support window, not statistical confidence. No claim about the unresolved mathematical tangent exactly at the endpoint.

strands.notes: Upper dark tip is rounded/blurred; longer shaft rises to the right, terminal hook may turn left. Do not treat longer chord as endpoint ground truth.
